system: HK OPTIMAL V4 · DAILY RISK GUARD
evidenceStatus: HISTORICAL OPTIMISATION · DAILY RISK OVERLAY · SHADOW / FORWARD VALIDATION REQUIRED
operatingMode: MAX 1 BET/RACE · MAX 2 BETS/RACE DAY · -A$10K DAILY LOSS STOP · <=100 BETS/YEAR

decision.reason: V4 keeps V3's horse-selection thresholds and stake schedule but adds two live-feasible race-day controls. In the stored history it increased annual P/L, reduced stored drawdown, increased ROI, reduced the busiest-year bet count and improved day-block sequence stress. Because every historical bet removed by the overlay happened to lose, V4 must now be frozen and forward-tested rather than retuned again.

historical.method: Same V3 qualifying runners and stake schedule. Maximum one runner per race; maximum two confirmed HK bets per race day; no new HK bet after realised daily HK P/L reaches -A$10,000 or worse. No rebate. Winning profit portion stressed 3% worse than historical HKJC research odds.

dailyRiskGuard.lossStopRule: After each settled confirmed HK bet, if realised HK P/L for that race day is <= -A$10,000, take no more HK bets that day.
dailyRiskGuard.liveFeasibility: Uses only confirmed earlier bets and settled realised P/L from the same race day; no later-race outcome is used to make an earlier decision.
dailyRiskGuard.historicalRemovedBetObservation: All 13 removed bets across completed history plus the 2026 partial happened to be losses. This improves the backtest but is also a material sequencing-overfit warning.

model.note: The calibrated model EV is the more conservative forward anchor. The A$110.8k historical annual result is an optimized historical path, not an income forecast.

risk.riskParityStatus: STORED V4 HISTORICAL DD BELOW AU RECORDED DD · STRESS STILL MATERIAL
risk.riskParityReason: V4's stored chronological drawdown is A$75,766. Different ordering of race-day blocks can still produce substantially deeper drawdowns.

sequenceStress.method: 10,000 deterministic random permutations of completed-history race-day P/L blocks, seed 20260904. Whole race days are kept intact because V4's two-bet/day and daily-loss rules depend on same-day chronology. Descriptive stress only, not a probability forecast.

selectionRules.raceSelection: Highest verified calibrated model EV among qualifying runners; tie lower odds, then higher original raw model EV.

optimizerScope.antiClusterRule: Maximum one selected runner per race.
optimizerScope.dailyRiskRule: Maximum two confirmed selections per race day and stop after realised daily HK P/L <= -A$10,000.
optimizerScope.calendarYearRule: Maximum 100 confirmed HK bets per calendar year.
optimizerScope.warning: The rule and risk overlay were selected using historical outcomes and can overfit. V4 should be frozen for genuine forward validation after the source cutoff.

liveExecution.message: Fail closed. Do not place a Hong Kong bet until model classification, within-race calibrated-EV ranking, executable WIN price, capacity, year count, today's confirmed HK bet count and today's realised HK P/L are all verified.

caveats: HK OPTIMAL V4 is a historically optimized research candidate, not production-approved.
The horse-selection thresholds and stakes are unchanged from V3; V4 adds only the race-day risk guard.
All historical V3 bets removed by the new daily guard happened to lose. That may be genuine risk control benefit, but it is also a strong sequencing-overfit warning.
A$75,766 is the stored chronological historical drawdown, not a guaranteed maximum. Race-day-block sequence stress is materially larger.
Historical HKJC research/closing prices plus a 3% adverse-price stress are not the same as verified live accepted bookmaker prices.
The A$110.8k annual historical result is not a forward forecast; calibrated model EV is about A$18.3k/year.
2026 is partial through the source cutoff and is not a completed year.
Freeze V4 and collect fresh forward evidence rather than continuing to retune the historical sample.
